title: Learn the Directions, Normalize the Gains: Post-Training Normalization for LoRA
abstract: arXiv:2610.02067v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: While Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) enables efficient task specialization, its learned updates can compromise capabilities beyond the target task. We identify \textbf{adaptation imbalance}: a few singular directions dominate the trained update, leaving its performance sensitive to how gains are allocated. We argue that \textbf{learning where to adapt does not ensure that adaptation gains are well balanced}. This motivates \textbf{LoRA-Norm}, a post-training normalization method that retains learned directions while rebalancing their gains. LoRA-Norm combines spectral rebalancing, a fixed nonlinear transformation of singular values, with nuclear-norm restoration, which preserves the original total spectral mass. It requires no calibration data or additional training and introduces no inference overhead. translated_title: 学习方向，规范化增益：LoRA的训练后规范化方法
translated_abstract: 虽然低秩适应（LoRA）能够实现高效的任务专门化，但其学习到的更新可能会损害目标任务之外的能力。我们识别出“适应不平衡”现象：少数奇异方向在训练后的更新中占主导地位，使其性能对增益的分配方式非常敏感。我们认为，学习在何处适应并不能保证适应增益得到良好平衡。这促使我们提出LoRA-Norm，一种训练后规范化方法，它在保留学习到的方向的同时重新平衡其增益。LoRA-Norm将谱重平衡（对奇异值进行固定的非线性变换）与核范数恢复（保持原始总谱质量）相结合。它不需要校准数据或额外训练，也不会引入推理开销。在两个骨干网络和三个适应任务上，LoRA-Norm提高了平均专门化能力和能力保持水平，优于所评估的方法。
tldr: 提出LoRA-Norm训练后规范化方法，通过谱重平衡与核范数恢复重新平衡LoRA的适应增益，在无需校准数据、额外训练和推理开销的情况下，同时提升任务专门化与原有能力保持。
en_tdlr: LoRA-Norm is a post-training normalization method that rebalances LoRA adaptation gains via spectral rebalancing and nuclear-norm restoration, improving both task specialization and capability retention without calibration data, additional training, or inference overhead.
